title: Cross-agent handoff: Claude peer to Codex peer
intro: A claude-host peer sends a task to a codex-host peer.
outro: Relay stored, handed out on read, and acknowledged on request. Nobody was woken: every host polls.

captions.caption: Each agent registers its own peer. Registering starts nothing.
Send returns a stored receipt (durable), not a delivery notification.
Reading never acknowledges: the same message is still unread.
A different registered peer sees nothing of this mailbox.
Acknowledging someone else's message counts zero.
The answer joins the same conversation as a new, durable message.
